steps.content:
March 15, N.F. 113, 22:51
Secret Passage, Level 28, East District, Drifter Camp
The pipe is broken and spattering water everywhere, but still unable to put out the scattered black embers.
Two figures are stuck in a corner piled with Mania contamination. Che sits with his back against the wall, his right hand reaching out to restrain K.K. and cover her mouth from behind.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Mmph...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Close your mouth, hold still.

<size=30>He holds his breath completely and his entire body is straining, tilting his head to glare beyond the corner. K.K. can only follow his gaze out of the corner of her eye. She looks past the metal plate blocking them, past the torn pieces of a black raincoat, and sees the exit of the dark alley.</size>
Over the spattering noise of water, another eerie sound comes from the other end of the dark alley.
Tap. Tap. Tap. The sound of leather shoes. There's only one person, stepping over the puddle and filth, coming this way.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Quiet. Hold your breath...</color>
His voice is almost inaudible, but the hand on her mouth keeps tightening, dragging K.K. deeper into the contamination.

Wriggling, the rotten contamination can't break through the shackles and hurt K.K., but it's crawling onto the boy's skin, corrupting him slowly. Che remains motionless, treating it as a kind of cover of their existence.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=40>Hold your breath...</color></size>
As the footsteps near, even more rustling noise creeps closer. Eerie sounds of wind crash against the narrow passage. K.K.'s muscles are straining almost to the point of tearing.
...It's those monsters. Those monsters with no faces, only <color=#fb9259>marks of a single red eye</color>!
Che doesn't speak anymore. He triggers the mechanism with a finger of his left hand. The sound of something shattering comes from the far end.
Those howling monsters pause and begin sprinting that way, rushing out of the alley like hyenas smelling prey. The taps of the leather shoes stop, but that person doesn't turn back.
Mania Crystal...? Ha... A small trick.
He keeps going in the original direction and walks inward. The spattering water hits something like a taut tent... An umbrella.
Che grits his teeth and grabs the short ax next to him. He exerts his muscles, but only pulls K.K. further back. She finally makes out the face of her companion...
Anxiety, hatred, and fear she's never seen before... along with a kind of determination that gives her chills.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: No...
Tap... All of a sudden, the footsteps stop. What comes next is the displeased voice of a man.
...What's the matter?
Hmm... Now? I've finally gotten into the mood to do some overtime work. Why don't you report that tomorrow?
Ha... After running for so many years, she came to you once she showed her face? Why?!
An icy chill sweeps in. The air in the alley suddenly presses down on them. Che's body stiffens instantly.
...I forgot myself. Wait for me, I'll head back now. Thanks for letting me know. If possible, keep her for a bit longer. I'm eager to meet my old friend.
The matters here have been properly arranged. It's a bit of a hassle, but they're a mob after all. I like having dealings with them.
By the time you arrive, <color=#fb9259>it</color> should be ready too...

He closes the umbrella and points the tip to the ground. A hole appears out of nowhere. The man quickly tumbles into the black flames. The hole closes again, leaving no trace, as if it's never appeared.

After a while, only silence remains. Che triggers a mechanism again. The Mania Crystal hidden in another spot shatters and activates a sharp wave of energy. It's his crystal, but this time it doesn't attract any monsters. They've already retreated.
The boy finally lets go of K.K., sliding into the filth like his whole body is giving out.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=42>Che!</size>
She drags Che away from the contamination immediately. Mania corruption happens very slowly, but he's already injured. He'll feel even worse without ${PlayerName}'s shackles.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=40>What was that thing just now?! It's hunting you down?! That's neither a Corruptor nor a human?!</color>

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I saw them, all those new injuries on you. You must have gotten them in the past couple months even if they're not recent. What did you guys do in the past six months? Who did you mess with?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=40>Where's Bai Yi? Why isn't she with you?!</color>

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=40>Did something happen to her too?!</color>

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Jeez, stop yelling mom... My head still hurts...
The boy coughs and tilts his head limply, just like how he used to fake sick to skip work in the past.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: It's been half a year... This should be an emotional reunion, why are you getting mad... Is it the utility bills... Or...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Tsk, I forgot to clean up after the last hotpot I had. I hope the place didn't get...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You little piece of ****!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Ouch, ouch! Mom I am sorry...
He asked for it, but now he can only hiss weakly. K.K. finally swallows her anger and dresses his wounds swiftly. She bows her head and wraps Che's arm around her shoulders to help him up.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Get up, we'll go to ${PlayerName}. The wounds are dressed, but he has to do something with the contamination.
steps.female_content: Get up, we'll go to ${PlayerName}. The wounds are dressed, but she has to do something with the contamination.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: That man is the mastermind behind this, isn't he? You'll explain it to ${PlayerName}. He's looking into this case too. He's way more reliable than the two of you combined, so don't try to hide anything.
steps.female_content: That man is the mastermind behind this, isn't he? You'll explain it to ${PlayerName}. She's looking into this case too. She's way more reliable than the two of you combined, so don't try to hide anything.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...Alright. But he's surrounded by people working for that Spider from Paradeisos. I must be careful somehow.
steps.female_content: ...Alright. But she's surrounded by people working for that Spider from Paradeisos. I must be careful somehow.

steps.content: Either because he has lost too much blood or he's calmed down, he seems rather dazed. After he mutters that, he realizes he's let the truth slip.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Ah, no. I mean, I borrowed money from him before. I must hide from him.
steps.female_content: Ah, no. I mean, I borrowed money from her before. I must hide from her.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Don't you pull that trick again!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I finally seized the chance to come back. I was gonna pay off all the debts and look for you guys. But when I got to Whitestone, there was no one, and the seal was already dusty.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=40>And when I finally found you, we barely talked before we encountered those monsters. You even tried to abandon me and run away a few times.</size>

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: <size=40>You're already so badly hurt now, and you still refuse to talk? Am I really not worth your trust?</size>
No response. It's hard to tell if he's passed out. With a knot in her chest, K.K. eventually quiets down and walks out of the dark alley with heavy steps.
They're no doubt the closest people to her. She understands these two want to protect her. But that aggrieved feeling is hard to shake, and now she doesn't even understand what exactly she's feeling.
The descending emergency elevator is right before her, and the other end of the shackles seems to be right below. Whatever Che can't tell her... he'll tell that to ${PlayerName}, won't he?
${PlayerName} will protect him and the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: If that person... hadn't brought you back, I wouldn't have had to risk it...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...What?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What's the point of sending you away...
He lifts his hand to press the elevator's button, staring at the tightening cable below.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Do you still remember what that man in black said on the phone? Once you see ${PlayerName}, tell him everything, word by word. And...
steps.female_content: Do you still remember what that man in black said on the phone? Once you see ${PlayerName}, tell her everything, word by word. And...

steps.content: K.K. gets knocked on the back of her head and her legs go limp. The elevator's gate opens and he tosses her in. The boy presses the button and turns around.
Stunned, she sees six men in raincoats standing behind him.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: It may sound a bit lame, but... run, K.K. Find ${PlayerName}. Find Julien. Find whoever you can, pass them the message, then leave. Make everyone leave. Don't look back, and don't ask questions.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You... want me to... leave... without you?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: I want you to stay alive. Whitestone's future depends on you. Also, running isn't as bad as it sounds.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: It's because I ran... I got to see the sun.

The boy grins. The gate closes and with a clack and the scratch of the cable, the elevator starts descending. Che spits out a mouthful of blood and looks at the enemies before him. Their faces are marked with the same familiar runes.

This time it's not the tracking hyenas, but the lurking assassins. The man with the umbrella laid a trap before leaving. He buried his sorcery on the only path, so that when the two stepped on it, they would rouse the monsters, and that would be the end of them.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Sigh... They used to take hostages alive. Do they really want us dead this time? What should I do...
The sound of the elevator's cable rolling behind reassures him. Before him, the monsters wriggle closer, those scarlet single eyes as disgusting as ever.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Alright, I'll pay my own debt this time. Besides...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: You guys owe me quite a few things too.
Mania's power begins flowing. The boy draws his ax and dagger, his eyes flashing fiercely. But before he charges, he hears a sudden clack behind him.
The elevator is here again. The gate opens, and a high kick comes flying, sending him to the side.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What the?!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Did you think you got me with that cotton punch?! In your ******* dreams!
She's ruined the vibe completely. Three more people walk out of the elevator.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yo, blondie's here? How come we see you everywhere we go?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief's right. The enemies are with K.K. But why do they target you, K.K.?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: How do I know? I'm not good at these mind games. Isn't the one with the most crooked mind right behind you?

You walk out of the elevator. K.K.'s presence already surprises you, you didn't expect to see the familiar face from <color=#fb9259>Keylan Square</color> as well. Didn't you still owe him something six months ago?
Anyway, let's repay this debt first.
